lines.en: I drift at my master's side.

lines.zh: 我的光在黑暗里一明一灭。
lines.en: My light pulses in the dark.

lines.zh: 我吊在你后面不远不近。
lines.en: I hang behind you, neither near nor far.

lines.zh: 我的身体像一团幽蓝的火。
lines.en: My body is a clot of blue fire.
I skim over the moss.
I never stray far.
I drift ahead to scout.
I return to his shoulder.
My light plays on the cave wall.
I drift over a sculk patch.
I pause, then follow again.
I keep half a step behind.
I hover, gently bobbing.
I circle my master once.
My light is quiet.
I wait for him to point.
I draw close, then away.
I am watching what he holds.
My glow flickers.
I have no feet and need none.
I hover, my light turning slowly.
I hang here without stirring my glow.
I turn to look at you.
There is something on you.
I carry my light up to your face.
My master has not told me to move.
Blue light falls into your eyes.
Do not wave your hand.
I drift over to study you through my glow.
I cannot sense your breath.

lines.zh: 你的影子被我的光推开了。
lines.en: My light pushes your shadow aside.
I withdraw to my master.

lines.zh: 被打中的地方暗了一瞬。
lines.en: The struck spot goes dark for a moment.
I scatter slightly.
I re-form more slowly.
The blow scatters me; I gather again.
I dim.
My low hum is barely audible.
I am unsteady.
I am still here.
My light pins itself on you.
I will tell my master.
I have no belly to fill.

lines.zh: 这点东西点不亮我的光。
lines.en: That much will not kindle my light.
Put it away. I cannot touch such things.
I only take what my master offers.
The staff that called me keeps me fed.
Your hand cannot catch a light.
That has no smell.
I drift above it.
That morsel has nothing to do with me.
I shake my head and my light wavers.
You pass through, taking only the cold.
I scatter and re-form.
My light flinches.
The back of your neck is the coldest spot.
I pull back.
I have no body to collide with.
I drift above your head.
I slip around to your other side.
We never actually touched.
The chill makes you flinch.
The staff that called me decides.
Other wisps are nothing to me.
The wisps summoned beside me are only shadows.
A staff called me forth.
I circle that staff.

lines.zh: 我在别的游灵前收敛了光。
lines.en: I dim myself before other wisps.
I leave nothing behind.
Call me back and I scatter.
I hover where I was.
Waiting for the next time.
I hold it with my glow wrapped around it.
I carry it to my master.

lines.zh: 它在我光里没什么分量。
lines.en: It has no weight inside my glow.
I drift with it in tow.
It grows cold in my hold.
I look and set it down.
I cannot hold it steady.
It passed through me.
My light cannot hold this thing.
I give it to you.
My master pointed.
I drift at you with the cold ahead of me.
The whole mass burns blue at once.
I circle you looking for a gap.
I fix on your position.
Whatever my master wants, I go at once.
This time it is not just looking.
This light has settled on you.
My light gathers into a clot.
Wherever you back away, my light follows.
I am fast.
I come up against your back.
Now, this very moment, I lunge.
Stand still. My glow is already on you.
I cut ahead and block your path.

lines.zh: 主人一抬手，我便朝你亮起来。
lines.en: My master raises a hand, and I brighten toward you.
My light spins faster.
I follow without leaving.
My light clings to your shadow.
You turn; I am above.
I rise from the floor.
I spread into blue haze.
The air at your feet grows cold.
I gather back into shape.
You are running for the exit.
I am at the exit.
My glow presses in inch by inch.
My master is still watching.
I do not breathe, and I do not tire.
I am always just behind your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我从半空跟着你的脚步。
lines.en: I trail your footsteps from above.
The blue swells to its fullest.

lines.zh: 那点窸窣声是我在靠近。
lines.en: That faint rustle is me closing in.
The blue shape on the wall is me.
I am right behind you.
Only two more steps remain.
Stop.
My light strikes you.

lines.zh: 一股寒气钻进你的甲缝。
lines.en: Cold seeps into the seams of your armor.
I press against your face.
I rise from under your feet.
My light sears once.
You swing; I scatter.
Scattered to mist, I gather again.
Your breath turns white.
I strike again.
The cold drives you back.
That blow cost me much of my glow.
I circle slowly.
Your fingertips go numb with cold first.
I am back.
The light gathers to a point.
This is the last strike.

lines.zh: 召唤杖亮了一下，我成形了。
lines.en: The staff flared and I took shape.
I surface out of the sculk.
My first glow is faint.

lines.zh: 我绕着召唤者转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle my summoner once.
I have chosen my master.
I hover at his shoulder.
My light falls on the moss.
I lift my head to him.
The dark here suits me.
I sway gently.
I wait for you to point the way.
My light settles.
I am with you.
I float within three paces of my master.

lines.zh: 火对光没用，可我还是烫了一下。
lines.en: Fire does nothing to light, yet it stings.

lines.zh: 我从高处飘落，没有摔到。
lines.en: I drift down from above and never land hard.

lines.zh: 水吞掉我的光，我在里面暗了。
lines.en: Water swallows my light and I dim inside it.
The blast blows me into a wisp of smoke.
The arrow passes through my light.

lines.zh: 别人的咒语压过我的光。
lines.en: Another spell overpowers my glow.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我的光在弱。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet my light weakens.

lines.zh: 雷光比我亮，我缩了一下。
lines.en: The lightning is brighter than I; I flinch.
The void drinks my light away.
